text:
maria: Hey team, need a swap for my oncall this Saturday (June 12) 05:00-09:00 UTC. Family appointment; can do a 30m handoff beforehand.

maria: Note: theres a planned docker image rollout for service `api` at 06:30 UTC. Low-risk but could cause transient 5xx spikes during warmup. Runbook steps below.

oncall-bot: Scheduled deployment: api:docker-image:prod:20260612-1 at 06:30 UTC (triggered by ci/cd)

ash: I can cover the slot. Ill be reachable by phone during 06:15-07:00 UTC (wont be at my desk the whole time). Is that sufficient? :phone: 

devon: Quick Q for the coverer will there be an auto-rollback? Whats the canary plan? Trying to decide how long to stay glued to alerts.

maria: Canary plan: 06:30-06:40 (10% traffic), 06:40-06:50 (50%), then full. CI has healthchecks and will auto-rollback if error rate >3% for 5m.

maria: Short handoff checklist:
- confirm canary traffic phase starts and health checks pass
- watch `kubectl rollout status deployment/api --watch`
- monitor 5xx rate on prod-api route and p50/p95 latency
- be ready to trigger rollback via CI if errors exceed threshold

maria: Commands I use:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/api --watch
# check recent logs if you see errors:
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/api -l release=prod --tail=200
```

sam: Ill be async backup on the alert channel; can jump in if pager fires.

luca: FYI the new image lowers MAX_CONN default. If upstreams show connection resets, thats the likely cause saw a flake in staging earlier.

ash: Ill take it. Maria, can you drop the runbook link and any dash links / creds I might need? Ill do handoff at 05:30.

maria: Runbook: https://internal.docs/runbooks/oncall-api-rollout
Dashboards: Prod -> API -> Overview (links in runbook)
Credentials: service account is used normally; Ill DM a temporary jump session token if you need console access.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: @ash will cover for maria on 2026-06-12 05:00-09:00 UTC. Notifying 30m before handoff.

devon: If canary fails, escalation path? Pager SRE team, then `#releases` notification and CI rollback, correct?

maria: Correct. Ill also post a short note in `#releases` before we start so the release owner sees it.

ash: Got it. Ill be on from 05:30 for handoff and available around the rollout. Thanks Maria have a good family day :heart:

maria: Thanks Ash appreciate it. Ill leave a brief post-roll summary in this thread if anything odd happens.
